core.headline: New three-bed semi at Kings Hill with air source heat pump
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house, The Larch, at Orchard Rise, Kings Hill, West Malling. Completion is expected spring 2027. The property has an air source heat pump, underfloor heating to the ground floor, and an EV charging point with two allocated parking spaces.

The ground floor has a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). The first floor has three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with an en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside is a turfed rear garden with a patio. There are two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

Kings Hill is approx. 2 miles from West Malling station. The property is sold with a 10-year NHBC warranty and is offered with no onward chain.

Fixed Price £410,000. Freehold. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage. Heating by air source heat pump; underfloor heating downstairs, radiators upstairs. FTTP broadband. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026. EPC B is a predicted rating (SAP); the final EPC will be issued on completion.
core.summary: New-build semi-detached house completing spring 2027 in Kings Hill. Air source heat pump, underfloor heating, EV charging point, two allocated spaces, en-suite to principal bedroom and 10-year NHBC warranty. Freehold, no chain.
